messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Field Count Error.
parts:
Hi Martin,

Try installing EBImage in R (https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/EBImage.html):

install.packages("BiocManager") 
BiocManager::install("EBImage")

However, your image is going to be almost impossible to count using our segmentation approach. The plants must be very well separated shapes.

Hope it helps,
Filipe
